boundary: Read-only sanitized audit; no file was deleted, renamed, merged, deprecated, or promoted, and no external caller absence is claimed.

methods.candidate_workaround: Introduce or retain a family-current internal engine behind compatible public entry points.
methods.expected_fail_witness: A fixture or caller fails against the candidate remaster and is retained.
methods.expected_pass_witness: The focused valid fixture and compatibility caller pass without changing protected gates.
methods.failure_signature: A remaster changes or removes an entry point without caller, behavior, rollback, and failure-retention evidence.
methods.promotion_gate: Promote only after an exact bounded pass witness and Method Flow validation.
methods.recurrence_guard: Audit callers and frozen evidence before implementation; never use age or naming alone as deletion authority.
methods.rollback: Restore routing to the previous entry point and retain the failed remaster witness.
methods.sibling_recommendation: Prefer family-current names for new reusable work; keep historical names as compatibility and evidence surfaces.
trigger_preconditions: The affected surfaces share a demonstrated responsibility and the owner controls an additive lane.
